title: Ike's Morning Digest
data_note: Built from publisher RSS metadata (titles + teaser text). `coverage_window_hours` is the default (40h); several feeds use a longer `rollingHours` (see `scripts/build-digest.mjs`) so rows align with what is still on each publisher’s listing pages. Commercial Observer keeps its retail category + hub supplement; TRD adds a New York–filtered global retail tag feed. section_overviews.commercial_observer:
Gravity Fitness Signs 23K-SF Lease at Queens’ Flushing Plaza: An athletic club is following a gravitational pull leading it to eastern Queens. Gravity Fitness signed a long-term, 23,000-square-foot lease at Muss Development ’s Flushing Plaza at 41-61 Kissena Boulevard , where it will occupy the ground floor of a two-story office and retail complex in Downtown Flushing, according.

BankUnited Lands Fifth Avenue Retail Flagship and Expands Offices at 450 Park Avenue: BankUnited is not only landing on Fifth Avenue with a new flagship branch, but it’s also expanding its office space along Park Avenue, Commercial Observer has learned. The Florida-based bank signed a retail lease for 10,068 square feet on the south corner of Amazon ’s tower at 452 Fifth Avenue , also known as 10.

Burlington Stores Inks 32K SF at Brooklyn Navy Yard’s Admiral’s Row Campus: Burlington Stores is coming to the Brooklyn Navy Yard. The retailer formerly known as Burlington Coat Factory signed a 31,717-square-foot retail lease at 25 Navy Street , according to city records filed Tuesday evening.

Zara Doubles Footprint at a Macerich Shopping Center in Los Angeles County: Fashion firm Zara is more than doubling its footprint at a Southern California shopping center. The clothing retailer is expanding from 22,000 square feet to a 45,000-square-foot flagship opening next year at Macerich ’s 1.3 million-square-foot Los Cerritos Center in southeast Los Angeles County.
section_overviews.cre_daily:
Record Diesel Prices Squeeze Retail Development Pipeline: Diesel averaged $6.38 per gallon on Sept. 28, up from about $3.81 in late February, adding to construction and supply-chain costs for retail developers and retailers.

Retail Demand Grows as Construction Hits Record Low: US retailers posted a net gain of 127 stores through Aug. 28, adding 28.6M SF of occupied retail space.

Arlington Redevelopment Gains Steam Near DFW Sports Hub: Trademark Property Co. broke ground in summer 2026 on the 404K SF Anthem, a $135M-plus redevelopment of the former Lincoln Square shopping center, with completion expected in early 2028.

Retail Sales Jump 6% in August, Boosting CRE Property Demand: Retail sales rose 6% year-over-year in August 2026 and have averaged 5.2% growth year-to-date, a pace historically uncommon outside post-recession recoveries. Households remain financially healthy overall, as rising incomes and record savings offset auto, credit card and household debt sitting at or near record highs.
section_overviews.new_york_post:
Bronx housing, retail site near planned new Metro-North station set to hit market: H+M and joint-venture partner Affinius Capital are exploring a sale of 1601 Bronxdale Ave., a 7.4-acre site close to the planned new Parkchester/Van Nest Metro-North station.

NYC doom loop? More like boom loop — as Manhattan office space fills up: Three major brokerages found that demand has driven up rents at a frenzied pace.

NYC now ranks as the hardest place to buy a home for first-time buyers: New York City is the hardest major US market for first-time homebuyers, who would need 65.2 years to save the typical $265,000 down payment.

San Francisco rent crisis hits staggering new highs as median rent now nearly $1k more than NYC: The median price for a two-bedroom apartment in San Francisco is now the highest in the country.

The vacant two-story development between Sands Street and Flushing Avenue borders the Wegmans -anchored shopping center at Admiral’s Row , an 8-acre mixed-use campus developed by Doug Steiner ’s development arm, Steiner NYC .…

items.summary: Fashion firm Zara is more than doubling its footprint at a Southern California shopping center. Zara’s existing store will remain open during construction. The property is at 239 Los Cerritos Center near the border between L.A. and Orange counties.…

items.headline: Chinese Restaurant Chain to Open 10K-SF Eatery at 365 West 46th Street
items.summary: One thing New York City does not lack is a place to find great Chinese food, and New Yorkers are about to get another spot to add to their lists. Nong Geng Ji , one of China’s most popular Hunan cuisine brands, has inked a 9,900-square-foot retail lease at 365 West 46th Street in Manhattan’s Hell’s Kitchen neighborhood along the famed Restaurant Row, according to tenant broker Meridian Capital Group . The three-level space will be the brand’s flagship New York City location.…

items.headline: Record Diesel Prices Squeeze Retail Development Pipeline
items.summary: Diesel averaged $6.38 per gallon on Sept. 28, up from about $3.81 in late February, adding to construction and supply-chain costs for retail developers and retailers. Just over 60M SF of retail is under construction, 4% above the all-time low CoStar has recorded, while JLL put Q2 vacancy at 4.4% and net absorption at 10.2M SF. Retailers such as Aldi, Burlington, TJ Maxx and Dollar Tree plan large store expansions, but flat rents and rising costs mean limited new supply to absorb them.…

items.headline: Retail Demand Grows as Construction Hits Record Low
items.summary: US retailers posted a net gain of 127 stores through Aug. 28, adding 28.6M SF of occupied retail space. Retail recorded 10.2M SF of positive Q2 net absorption while vacancy remained near 4.4%. Q2 completions fell to a record-low 5.2M SF as construction costs continued to outpace rent growth across most markets. Key Takeaways Bisnow reports that US retail leasing and store growth are accelerating while new construction remains constrained. Coresight Research counted a net gain of 127 store openings through Aug.…

items.headline: British Luxury Fashion Brand JW Anderson to Open at SoHo’s 138 Wooster Street
items.summary: British luxury fashion label JW Anderson has leased 4,500 square feet at 138 Wooster Street in Manhattan’s SoHo neighborhood for its first stand-alone U.S. store, Commercial Observer has learned. Founded in 2008 by Jonathan Anderson — the newly appointed creative director of Dior and a two-time British Fashion Awards Designer of the Year recipient — the influential fashion label is staking out a claim in a highly sought-after part of SoHo at a time when quality retail space in the neighborhood is increasingly…

items.headline: Solidcore Signs Lease for Fitness Studio at 1695 Second Avenue on Upper East Side
items.summary: A strength training brand has signed a retail lease on Manhattan’s Upper East Side. Solidcore , a national fitness chain that offers high-intensity workouts, took the entire retail component of Alchemy-ABR Investment Partners ’ 1695 Second Avenue , a new 23-story, 51-unit residential building on East 88th Street, according to landlord broker JLL .…

items.headline: Core Retail Sales Hit Record as In-Store Spending Rises
items.summary: Core retail sales rose 1.2% in August and 5.6% year over year, with gains across nine of 10 major retail categories. Store-based sales increased 0.6%, outpacing headline inflation and marking the second-largest monthly gain in the past 14 months. Preliminary Q3 2026 data showed positive net absorption across single- and multi-tenant retail, with supply roughly in line with demand. Key Takeaways Consumer spending strengthened broadly in August, supporting both online and physical retail.…

items.headline: Italian Restaurant Casa Serra to Open at 227 Front Street in South Street Seaport
items.summary: Lower Manhattan’s South Street Seaport will be living la dolce vita with its latest restaurant lease. Casa Serra , a sister restaurant to East Village eatery House of Pasta , has inked a 2,824-square-foot lease at the Durst Organization ’s 227 Front Street , the landlord announced Tuesday. The 15-year lease has an asking rent of $100 per square foot.…

items.headline: Happier Grocery to Open Second NYC Location on the Upper East Side
items.summary: A healthy grocery retailer is opening its second New York City location on Manhattan’s Upper East Side. Happier Grocery has signed a 20,500-square-foot lease at CSC Real Estate ’s 210 East 86th Street , where it plans to open a health food store like its original one on Canal Street in the second half of 2027, according to landlord broker Avison Young .…

items.headline: Phillips Edison Expands Grocery-Anchored JV With Northwestern
items.summary: Phillips Edison extended its Northwestern Mutual partnership by 10 years and plans to move 13 centers valued around $377.5 million into the venture. At completion, Grocery Retail Partners I is expected to hold more than 40 centers in 17 states, roughly $1.2 billion of assets, with Northwestern owning 86%. Phillips Edison updated its 2026 guidance to $600 million to $700 million in gross acquisitions, as grocery ranks first in Cushman & Wakefield’s performance ranking by sales volume.…

items.headline: Men’s Grooming Club John Allan’s Moves to 4 East 46th Street
items.summary: A men’s grooming and hair brand is moving its flagship location to Midtown East. John Allan’s signed a 3,000-square-foot lease at Jeong Hoon Kim ’s 4 East 46th Street , where it will provide an exclusive experience for its members in a relocation from 575 Fifth Avenue , according to tenant broker CBRE . The length of the lease was not disclosed, but asking rent for the building was $60 per square foot, according to CBRE.…

items.headline: Toys R Us Bets on Brick and Mortar With 120 New Stores
items.summary: Toys R Us operator WHP Global has an ambitious plan to open 120 U.S. stores this holiday season. The private equity-backed brand-management company partnered with Go! Retail Group , a seasonal pop-up operator, to launch the new locations, according to an announcement last week . Shoppers nationwide can expect the new stores to be on the smaller side, the Boston Globe reported , and only temporary.…

items.headline: Sephora’s Meatpacking District Store Relocates to 401 West 14th Street
items.summary: Beauty retailer Sephora is taking a walk up the block to 401 West 14th Street . The makeup giant has signed a 4,200-square-foot deal with landlords Taconic Partners and Nuveen Real Estate to relocate its Meatpacking District store one block north from 21-27 Ninth Avenue , according to the landlords. Cushman & Wakefield ’s Jason Greenstone represented the landlords, while Virginia Pittarelli of Retail by MONA negotiated the deal on behalf of Sephora.…

items.summary: Commercial real estate law firm Adler & Stachenfeld (A&S) is relocating its New York City offices within Midtown.
